title: SearXNG
descript: SearXNG is a privacy-respecting metasearch engine: it queries dozens of search services and aggregates the results without profiling you, and nothing is kept on a third-party account. Run it once on your NAS and search from any browser; other apps can use its JSON API. Each install generates its own session secret in the application data folder on first start.
release_note: 1. First release: SearXNG 2026.11.8 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Private metasearch with a per-install secret, JSON API available, config persisted in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). The first start writes DockerAppData/searxngdocker/config/settings.yml with a unique secret and image proxy enabled - edit that file to rename the instance or change engines. The request limiter is disabled here so a family can search from several devices; turn it back on before exposing the instance publicly. Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy for internet access. Back up the config folder before uninstalling with data removal.

github.description: SearXNG is a free internet metasearch engine which aggregates results from various search services and databases. Users are neither tracked nor profiled.

zh-cn.descript: SearXNG 是一款注重隐私的元搜索引擎：一次查询会同时检索数十个搜索服务并汇总结果，不给你画像，也不会把记录留在第三方账号里。在 NAS 上跑一份，任何浏览器都能用，其他应用还能调用它的 JSON API。每次安装都会在应用数据目录里生成独立的会话密钥。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。首次启动会写入 DockerAppData/searxngdocker/config/settings.yml，内含随机密钥并开启图片代理；要改实例名或搜索引擎就编辑这个文件。本包默认关闭了请求限流，方便家里多台设备同时搜索；把实例公开到公网前请重新开启。界面为纯 HTTP，外网访问请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。卸载并删除数据前请先备份 config 目录。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 SearXNG 2026.11.8，以非 root 容器运行。隐私元搜索，每次安装独立密钥，提供 JSON API，配置持久化在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: SearXNG 是一款注重隱私的元搜尋引擎：一次查詢會同時檢索數十個搜尋服務並彙總結果，不給你畫像，也不會把紀錄留在第三方帳號裡。在 NAS 上跑一份，任何瀏覽器都能用，其他應用還能呼叫它的 JSON API。每次安裝都會在應用資料目錄裡產生獨立的會話密鑰。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。首次啟動會寫入 DockerAppData/searxngdocker/config/settings.yml，內含隨機密鑰並開啟圖片代理；要改實例名稱或搜尋引擎就編輯這個檔案。本包預設關閉了請求限流，方便家裡多台裝置同時搜尋；把實例公開到互聯網前請重新開啟。介面為純 HTTP，外網存取請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。解除安裝並刪除資料前請先備份 config 目錄。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 SearXNG 2026.11.8，以非 root 容器運行。隱私元搜尋，每次安裝獨立密鑰，提供 JSON API，設定持久化在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/etc/searxng` (mounted from `DockerAppData/searxngdocker/config`) holds `settings.yml`: the instance name, the generated `secret_key`, the enabled engines and the limiter switch.
design_notes: **Per-install secret.** The image generates `secret_key` into the mounted settings file on first start, so no secret is baked into the package.
**Limiter off for LAN use.** `SEARXNG_LIMITER=false` keeps a family from hitting 429s; re-enable it before any public exposure.
**No external services of its own.** SearXNG scrambles the request through the engines you enable; nothing is stored outside the container.
limitations: - The web UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
- With the limiter disabled, a public instance would be easy to abuse - only do that behind auth.
- Some engines are blocked or rate-limited from certain networks (the log lists the ones that failed to register); editing `settings.yml` lets you drop them.
